text: The 2021 tree-cover loss in this pine plantation was most likely caused by timber harvesting. The loss area (81.3 ha) aligned with planted *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*, with 98% of the area confirmed as forest by the JRC reference. The event was captured in both Hansen GFC and MGAP datasets, meeting the corroboration rule. Additionally, 37.3 ha of smaller patches were excluded from the total loss, suggesting systematic clearing rather than natural or fragmented disturbances. The absence of native forest and the presence of commercial pine species further support the conclusion of planned harvesting.
